World & intervention rules

All 5,044 catalogue stars remain eligible. This scene uses deterministic synthetic depths and ideal tag/range measurements. Four ranges solve position, bearings solve orientation, and four held-out stars test the fix. Background dust is atmosphere, not evidence.

Preview a push gives a bounded impulse in the camera’s plane. A graphical gravity edit moves a fictional harmonic well within 0.1 ly of the ship. Inside its 0.3 ly region, acceleration is −(position − well center) in ly/year². It acts for π/2 years, then expires with velocity preserved. Its price is 6 fuel + 100 × handle displacement in ly. Preview, tracers and actual flight share the same force and clock. The guided handle selects a computed intercept; it cannot turn any painted curve into a valid path.

Field release applies the quoted force, not an instantaneous velocity correction. Undo rewinds the whole edit and subsequent flight, including time, resources, finite deposits and ledger. Arrival requires both position within 0.002 ly of home and speed below 0.00001 ly/year.

Game credits are fictional and separate from real model usage. Live Astra uses the local Codex bridge. Failed calls spend no game credits. The Earth plate appears only after verified braking and arrival; it is a narrative image, not a navigable globe.
